{{Quote|Ahhh, Basdor, you're here, but you seem confused. You're standing with the wrong side, aren't you?|Admiral Pellaeon|<ref name="ce3.6" />}}
'''Zam Basdor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] dignitary of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the right hand man of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. After secretly making a deal with [[Ennix Devian]], the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Restored Empire]] faction, Basdor became a spy on Devian's behalf and sabotaged a [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|peace treaty]] that would have ended the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Upon learning of Basdor's true loyalties, Pellaeon executed Basdor during a [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|battle]] over the [[Orinda/Legends|Imperial capital]].

==Biography==
[[File:BasdorDead-CEIII6.png|thumb|left|150px|Basdor, shot between the eyes]]
{{Quote|So, Basdor&hellip; you're the spy I've been looking for. I suspected as much.|Admiral Pellaeon prior to executing Basdor|<ref name="ce3.6" />}}
Basdor, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], worked as a dignitary for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under the direction of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Operating on the Imperial homeworld, [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], Basdor eventually came into contact with [[Ennix Devian]], an extremist Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who founded a dissident Remnant group known as the [[Restored Empire]]. Promised something in return for his assistance, Devian appointed Basdor as a spy in Pellaeon's offices.<ref name="ce3.6" /> Basdor informed Devian of Pellaeon's decision to possibly make a truce with the warring [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and the two conspired to sabotage the peace talks in order to prolong the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ce3.3">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 3]]</ref>

Basdor was appointed by Pellaeon to oversee the meeting between [[Feena D'Asta]], representing the Imperial Remnant and the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]], and [[Mirith Sinn]], representing the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. This meeting would lay the foundations for a ceasefire. Basdor secretly had a squad of Devian's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] lying in wait to assassinate the two women; framing the attack on the New Republic would provoke the Pellaeon into launching a retaliatory attack on the Republic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to maintain Feena's [[Ragez D'Asta|father's]] loyalty to the Remnant; this in turn would allow Devian to strike at Orinda and destroy the Imperial Remnant. However, Basdor did not expect the presence of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]] at the meeting. Showing his disgust towards allowing the man who assassinated the previous head of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], [[Xandel Carivus]], to attend peace talks, Basdor vacated the room, and shortly after sent Devian's stormtroopers in to kill everyone presnt, resulting in the death of D'Asta. Kanos, however, saved Sinn's life and killed Basdor's men. Pellaeon questioned Basdor's decision to abandon D'Asta prior to the attack. Basdor maintained that he suspected treachery, and bolstered Pellaeon's decision to launch a strike at the heart of the New Republic; Pellaeon's fleet mobilized for the attack.<ref name="ce3.5" />

However, en route to Coruscant, Pellaeon was alerted of Devian's [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|attack]] on Orinda by Baron D'Asta; Kir Kanos relayed the truth of Feena's death to her father. Pellaeon's fleet reversed its course, and his flagship was boarded by Devian's men upon reentry in Orinda's orbit. Basdor was spared by Devian, who managed to corner Pellaeon and force him into a surrender. Pellaeon's suspicions surrounding Basdor were amplified when he saw the dignitary standing with Devian's men, unharmed. Devian confirmed Basdor's true loyalties; enraged, Pellaeon raised his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and killed Basdor with a single shot to the forehead.<ref name="ce3.6" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zam Basdor first appeared as a minor antagonist in the comic series [[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost|''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III—Empire Lost'']] in [[2012]]. Debuting in its [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5|fifth issue]], Basdor's true loyalties were not revealed until the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 5|following issue]]; references to a spy within Pellaeon's ranks are made as early as the [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 3|third issue]].
